description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Set this parameter to a value that is generated from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** value as the **ClientToken** value. The **RequestId** value is different for each API request.

description.zh: 待删除的基础型全球加速实例终端节点所属的终端节点组ID。
description.en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint that you want to delete belongs. You can call the [ListBasicEndpointGroups](~~~~) operation to query the endpoint group ID of a basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

description.zh: 待删除的基础型全球加速实例终端节点ID。
description.en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to delete from the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

description.zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator instance. Set the value to **ap-southeast-1**.

title.zh: 删除基础型全球加速实例的终端节点
title.en: Delete an endpoint of a basic global accelerator instance

descriptions.zh:
- **DeleteBasicEndpoint**接口属于异步接口，即系统会先返回一个请求ID，但终端节点未删除完成，系统后台的删除任务仍在进行。您可以调用[ListBasicEndpoints](~~466831~~)查询终端节点的状态：
    - 当终端节点状态为**deleting**时，表示终端节点正在删除中，在该状态下，您只能执行查询操作，不能执行其他操作。
    - 当查询不到该终端节点时，表示终端节点已删除完成。
- **DeleteBasicEndpoint**接口不支持在同一个基础型全球加速实例内并发删除终端节点。
descriptions.en:
- **DeleteBasicEndpoint** is an asynchronous operation. After a request is sent, the system returns a request ID, but the endpoint is not yet deleted and the deletion node continues in the background. You can invoke [ListBasicEndpoints](~~466831~~) to query the status of the endpoint:
    - If the endpoint is in the **deleting** state, the endpoint is being deleted. In this state, you can only execute query operations.
    - If the endpoint cannot be found, the endpoint is deleted.
- **DeleteBasicEndpoint** does not support concurrent deletion of endpoints within the same basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga delete-basic-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --endpoint-id ep-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --region cn-hangzhou
